parsed.post: Significant improvement! Found a drop to 1.044888 by exploring the LR/scale axis. Moving away from the baseline settings. Next, I'll test increasing DEPTH and ASPECT_RATIO to scale the model capacity, as agent-0 suggested larger models might perform better.
